Inherited from Manichaean Middle Persian 𐫟𐫇𐫏 (xwy /⁠xōy⁠/). Compare Old Armenian խոյր (xoyr), Persian خود (xôd).

Inherited from Manichaean Middle Persian 𐫅𐫇𐫢𐫖𐫁𐫎 (dwšmbṯ /⁠dōšambat⁠/, “Monday”). By surface analysis, دو (du /do) + شنبه (šanba /šanbe).
From Manichaean Middle Persian 𐫞𐫇𐫡𐫃 (qwrg /⁠kūrag⁠/, “furnace, kiln”). A Semitic borrowing. Compare Classical Syriac ܟܘܪܐ (kūrā, “melting pot; furnace”).
Inherited from Manichaean Middle Persian 𐫏𐫞𐫢𐫖𐫁𐫤 (yqšmbt /⁠yakšambat⁠/, “Sunday”). By surface analysis, یک (yak /yek, “one”) + شنبه (šanba /šanbe), literally “one (day after) Saturday”.
